rationale: The interpreter output incorrectly specifies the label for displaying the calculated height as "DX height" instead of the exact required label "DX Coil Height" as stated in the ticket. This violates the core business requirement and would lead to incorrect UI labeling.

findings.description: The interpreter's business rule uses the label "DX height" instead of the required exact label "DX Coil Height".
findings.action: Update the businessRules to use the exact label "DX Coil Height" when displaying the calculated height.
